# infisical_secret_sync_azure_devops (Resource)

Create and manage Azure DevOps secret syncs

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_secret_sync_azure_devops" "app-configuration-demo" {
  name                    = "demo-sync"
  description             = "This is a demo sync."
  project_id              = "<project-id>"
  environment             = "dev"
  secret_path             = "/"
  include_all_sub_folders = false                 # Also sync secrets from folders beneath secret_path
  connection_id           = "<app-connection-id>" # The ID of your Azure DevOps App Connection

  sync_options = {}

  destination_config = {
    devops_project_id = "<devops-project-id>",
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the azure-devops Connection to use for syncing.
- `destination_config` (Attributes) The destination configuration for the secret sync. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_config))
- `environment` (String) The slug of the project environment to sync secrets from.
- `name` (String) The name of the Azure DevOps sync to create. Must be slug-friendly.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Infisical project to create the sync in.
- `secret_path` (String) The folder path to sync secrets from.
- `sync_options` (Attributes) Parameters to modify how secrets are synced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_options))

### Optional

- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Whether secrets should be automatically synced when changes occur at the source location or not.
- `description` (String) An optional description for the Azure DevOps sync.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) How long Terraform waits for syncs when wait_for_sync_completion is true. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_sync_completion` (Boolean) Whether Terraform waits for the sync to finish before it continues. On create, Terraform waits for the first sync. On update, Terraform first waits for a sync that is already in progress, then sends the update and waits for the sync that the update starts. If the sync fails, the apply fails with the error from Infisical. If the wait fails on create, Terraform marks the resource as tainted, and the next apply deletes and recreates the secret sync. If the configuration is correct and only the destination needs a fix, run `terraform untaint` on the resource instead. The wait has no effect when auto_sync_enabled is false, because Infisical then doesn't run a sync. Terraform waits up to the create and update values in timeouts (default: 10m). Defaults to false.
- `include_all_sub_folders` (Boolean) Whether to sync secrets from folders beneath the source path as well.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Azure DevOps secret sync

<a id="nestedatt--destination_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_config`

Required:

- `devops_project_id` (String) The ID of the Azure DevOps project to sync secrets to.


<a id="nestedatt--sync_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_options`

Optional:

- `disable_secret_deletion` (Boolean) When set to true, Infisical will not remove secrets from Azure DevOps. Enable this option if you intend to manage some secrets manually outside of Infisical.
- `key_schema` (String) The format to use for structuring secret keys in the Azure DevOps destination.


<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the first sync when wait_for_sync_completion is true, as a positive duration string such as "30s" or "15m". Defaults to 10m.
- `update` (String) How long to wait for syncs during an update when wait_for_sync_completion is true, as a positive duration string such as "30s" or "15m". Covers both the sync already in progress and the sync that the update starts. Defaults to 10m.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the Azure DevOps secret sync by its ID
terraform import infisical_secret_sync_azure_devops.example <secret_sync_id>
```
